label: Contract Target System
info: Reference Contract Target System (UC-05-01, DCS-IR-SI-02/-05): receives the DCS deployment dispatch, verifies the payload's canonical content hash, returns a synchronous ack, and then acts as a REAL target — it POSTs the authoritative acknowledgement callback (status + execution-evidence receipt) and a measured KPI report back to the DCS deployment-callback endpoint, authenticated as its own registered OAuth2 client (ADR-27, DCS-FR-SM-10/-12, DCS-FR-CWE-09/-31). One target may serve several DCS deployments, so the deployment-callback base URL and the token endpoint to authenticate against are taken from the dispatch (query parameters dcs_url and token_url on the registered target endpoint), falling back to this flow's DCS_URL / HYDRA_TOKEN_URL environment for a single-instance install.

name: Verify content hash and build ack
Request target access token
Build acknowledgement callback
Build measured KPI callback
Log rejected KPI callback
